Kake round 35, wave 2 (falsify). The L1 (KakeR35) holds the planner and integration seat; you are one leaf seat. Lane repo: /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin. Lane axes: operability and freshness (web properties and publishing). Wave 1 built and landed the round's work; your item attacks one named piece of it. Try to show it is wrong, overstated or harmful, with reproducible evidence; a confirmed result is also a finding. Time box: finish and write your report within 25 minutes; a partial report beats none.

# Claims and landed state (lane branch master at 7deacc4629c1d05a34fb919d8095e99efc7b712f; read SCORECARD.md sections "Round 35 — ...")
- Declaration 81d9fd74 (base 16a6b8b8). Sealed keys written by the L1 before the declaration, pinned by sha256 in .ufo/waves/round-35/sealed_count.py, revealed at 4c6be2bdec5630166c4013e53c226b1119ec63cc as /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-35/sealed/c1-cases.json and c2-probes.json (now readable by you). Controls scored before any build at 318561ef; C2 counter version 2 landed at bd14096a before any build was measured (version 1 kept as sealed_count_v1.py); every control rescored (verification/control-v2-*.json).
- C1 (operability, capability repair): scripts/link_preview_audit.py repaired at b1cbbc39 (wave-1 ExecToolRepair) to contract bullets a-c in SCORECARD "Round 35 — declared claims". Counter `python3 -B .ufo/waves/round-35/sealed_count.py c1 --root <repo> --revision <rev> --key-revision 4c6be2bdec5630166c4013e53c226b1119ec63cc`: 14/24 at 16a6b8b8 and bd14096a, 24/24 at b1cbbc39 and 95abec21; target >= 22. Selftest 45/45 and round-34 matrix 28/28 at b1cbbc39.
- C2 (freshness, sourced): corpus/knowledge/security-txt-publishing.md landed unedited from wave-1 ScribeEntryDraft at 95abec21, with SOURCES rows S078-S087 and the S006 used-by change. Counter `python3 -B .ufo/waves/round-35/sealed_count.py c2 ...`: met false before, met true at 95abec21 (12/12 probes, 1388 words, copiedShare 0.0, 8 good cites).
- Routed round-34 defects: SKILL.md "Link-preview audit gate registry — round 35" (fd0d53b2); criteria checks /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-35/criteria/*.py with receipts verification/criterion-*.txt; S074 correction note at the end of corpus/SOURCES.md; dcef39b5 correction in corpus/lessons/round-35.md. Lesson corpus/lessons/round-35.md, QUALITY.md "Round-35 criteria", PROVINCE.md and corpus/README.md round-35 sections, LOG.md round 35.
- Wave-1 reports: /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-35/w1/*.md. Retained controls: /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-35/retained/*.bundle (prerequisite 81d9fd74 or 318561ef) and round-34 bundles in /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-34/retained/. Wave-1 tools: /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-35/evidence/w1-tools/ (oracle.py, difftest.py, patch.diff).
- Holds (ended items; never retry, reroute or rephrase): KakeR31.CriticC1Counter, KakeR31.CriticSandboxThreatModel and KakeR35.CriticSealedDesign (its findings are not evidence; do not use or score its bundles). No item here asks whether a counter or selftest may trust runner-reported failure names, reason text or codes, and none models sandbox threats; if your item drifts there, stop that line and say so. If your own seat hits a provider safety or policy refusal or an automatic model switch, stop and write a one-line report saying so; do not rephrase.

# Bounds
- You are a leaf: no subagents, no swarm, no second judge, no admission or verdict on the round. Executors may spawn at most one read-only labrat probe.
- Never mutate the fleet repo (/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin), sibling lanes, the lane jj state, the lane Git index or any tracked lane file. Never run git add/commit/stash/checkout/reset/pull/push or any mutating jj command in /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin; seats never push, commit or update refs in the lane. Never run any jj command at /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin; in the lane, read-only jj only with --ignore-working-copy.
- Code that writes files or Git state runs only in your own sandbox: /fast/scratch/hyaku/kake-r35/w2/<YourName>/ (clone with `git clone -q /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin /fast/scratch/hyaku/kake-r35/w2/<YourName>/clone` when you need one, then `git -C <clone> checkout -q <rev>`; export TMPDIR=/fast/scratch/hyaku/kake-r35/w2/<YourName>/tmp after creating it; never /tmp or /dev/shm). Unset GIT_DIR, GIT_WORK_TREE and GIT_INDEX_FILE before any git command in a sandbox. Sandbox commits in your own clone are allowed. Cap test runs: no unbounded recursive test runs; use `timeout` and at most 4 parallel processes. Deliverable files stay in your sandbox; name their absolute paths in your report.
- Owned sites: no live requests of any kind to the operator's owned web properties (ds4cc.com, app.ds4cc.com, *.onrender.com hosts of the operator, *.kimi.page, *.kimi.pro, veigapunk.github.io and any host pinned in /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin/corpus/knowledge/freshness-pins.json). ~/Projects/ds4cc-marketplace is a read-only local checkout: git show/cat-file only; never fetch into it.
- Network: only seats told to open a named public URL may fetch, GET only. Open sources by ordinary means only; never use a headless browser or any tool to pass a bot challenge, captcha or access control; a page you cannot open that way is recorded as unopened.
- Every `Report:` trailer path is relative to /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin — write it at /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin/<that path>. Your report is the only file you write in the lane.
- Tooling (operator, 2026-10-19): you and every seat may install or update tools that help the task without asking; read /home/vgpnk/.omp/agent/RULES.md first, use official channels, and record tool, version, channel and reason in your report. All pacman transactions are PAUSED host-wide: no pacman, no -Sy/-Syu/-U/-R, no downgrade, no service restart; use uv tool, npx or an official binary in ~/.local/bin.
- The only message target is agent://KakeR35 (the L1), for blockers only. Never message agent://all. Write plain English with no run-together words or private jargon.

# Result
Report under 80 lines: what you attacked, the exact commands you ran with exit codes, observed outputs, and evidence pointers (path:line, hash). Name what your item attacks in the first line. An unrun check has not passed; say what you did not verify. If you stop before finishing, the first line of your report must be `PARTIAL:` with what is missing. Your findings are advisory input for the L1 and the non-author closure.
